# Synthetic plate detection fixture

Source: [fixture generator](../../../scripts/make-detector-motion-fixture.mjs).

Generated entirely from mathematical colors, shapes, and hand-defined glyphs. The plate text AB123CD is invented; this contains no real recording, person, vehicle, GPS, or external source material. The repository license applies.

The plate appears only between 1.2 and 1.6 seconds and moves 40 pixels per frame. A once-per-second scan misses the entire appearance. `long-motion.json` records every frame, including absent-object frames.
